Sylvie: Folllow-up from today's multi-region failover rehearsal. Found three repeat issues: 1) intermittent route-table drift after automated promotion, 2) backups in eu-west lagging the source by ~12-18m, 3) healthcheck flaps causing premature failovers. I sketched an action plan, need owners + quick timelines.
Alex: I'll take routing drift. Hypothesis: automation race between route-publisher and peer-table reconciliation. Plan: add idempotency tokens and reorder reconciliation to run after route publish. Target: proof-of-concept in 10 days.
Jamal: I'll cover backup lag & restore verification. Proposal: add a lightweight daily fast-restore smoke test in a low-cost AZ and track restore-time metric. Aim to ship in 5 business days.
Maria: I'll own the healthcheck tuning + runbook wording. Suggest we add a short grace window before triggering global failover (configurable per-app). Also will schedule a dry-run game-day for next Tue 03/16 05:00 PT.
ops-bot: Task created: 5124 "routing-reconciliation-fix" assigned to @Alex, due 10d. Task created: 5125 "backup-smoke-restore" assigned to @Jamal, due 5d.
Nina: Ops note: please avoid full-data restores during peak hours. Product prefers maintenance window at 05:00 PT. I can coordinate comms.
Alex: Quick checklist I'll implement: - add idempotency token to route publish API - run peer-table reconciliation as last step - add metric: route-diff-count by region - expose manual rollback endpoint
Jamal: Sketch of smoke-test script: ```bash
# quick restore of latest snapshot to t3.small in staging
SNAP_ID=$(aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod --query 'Snapshots[-1].SnapshotId' --output text)
aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SNAP_ID || exit 1
# attempt volume attach + boot minimal instance
```
Maria: Runbook pre-checks I'll add: 1) confirm KMS & cross-account keys 2) verify peering & route tables 3) confirm CAP policy for failover 4) contact list updated. I'll push changes to confluence and tag infra for review.
Sylvie: Ownership summary: Alex -> routing reconciliation (10d), Jamal -> backup smoke restores (5d), Maria -> runbook + game-day (dry-run 03/16 05:00 PT), Nina -> customer comms & maintenance window coordination. Ops-bot -> create recurring review for failover patterns weekly.
Alex: I'll also create a canary with 1% traffic for route changes and circuit-break to local-region if error rate >2% for 3m.
Jamal: For backups, set alert if replication lag > 8m twice in 24h. Escalate to infra rotation. I'll add dashboards.
ops-bot: Recurring task 5180 created: "weekly-failover-patterns-review" assigned to oncall-rotation, first run 03/09.
Maria: Quick question: do we want a schema-only smoke-restore first, or try schema+small-data?
Jamal: Start schema-only to validate path and speed, then run a full small-data restore after two successful runs. Document both in the runbook.
Sylvie: Good. Please reply here to confirm owners/timelines by EOD. I'll update the postmortem with final action items and mark P0/P1. :spiral_calendar:
Alex: Confirmed. PR for reconciliation queued, will link.
Jamal: Confirmed. Starting on dashboard + smoke-test tomorrow.
Maria: Confirmed. Scheduling the dry-run calendar invite now.
Nina: Confirmed. Will draft customer note post-dry-run.
Sylvie: Thanks everyone. Closing this loop after I publish the action tracker at 18:00 PT.
